translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Pita X Jon Nzvzmim Mz Kansrl Nyz Lr Jiu
Mzli kc Pita x Jon tzycmnebe-ngrbzlr mz leplz kcng, kzdung pris, x kxetu ngr pulis ngr Mangr-nzangiongr, x kzdung ncblo kxnzprtrng mz dzbede nyz lr Jiu nzrpibz Sadiusi sc tzyrkrpemqng badr.
Drtwrdr nzngyatx zlwz murde aposol kcng nzling tzalvztr-ngrdr leplz mz nzrpi-krbzlr badr kx Gct sa nabatrpzle mz leplz nztulz-krmlr mz nzbzngr, da kc tqwaibzle mz Jiszs.
Zbz nzlolvzlr Pita x Jon, x nzadwatrlr mz presin. X nzmncng elr krlzbzle nrlc kxngrlxobz, murde nrlc milzpqpe.
A' leplz nzkqlung nzlxngitilr nrpa kc tzyapwxtipxlr. X nzkqlukr ncblo kcng tzrlxngiti-kaing badr kxnzrlxngi-ateng, krlzbzle siu-nzlvqn (5,000), a' olvz badr doa kxnztopwzng trnzrlwxtrpwzung.
Nrlc ngrlxobz kxnzrmailz x lrtzlvzng ngr lr Jiu, x kxnzalvztrng mz Lou sc Mosis nzyrlwr-lxblrng mz Kansrl nyzdr mz mzteadau Jerusalem.
Kxnzmnc-kzng mrkc Anas kc ena tqngi Nardr Pris x kzdode Kaefzs kc tqngi Nardr Pris mzli lc, nidr badr Jon x Aleksada x kzdung kz ncblo kxnzetung mz lr ma nyz Nardr Pris kcng.

X Kansrl kc rkabz natq ngr nzrvzmi-ngrm Pita x Jon. Zbz mzli kc tztupe-ngrbzlr mz zpzu rdr, sc tzveapebzng badr. Nzrpibzlr kx, “?Myx kxmusr-ngrnamu nzamrlzngr ncblo lc tqbxplo? ?Aleamu mz zmatq ngr neke?”
Zbz Mqngrkxtr prsrle Pita, x sc tqrpipebzle badr kx, “Nimu kxnzrmailzng x lrtzlvz ngr Israel!
Vzmimamu nigr mrka murde nzamrlz-krgr ncblo lc. A' mz nzayzlu-krgr natqmu mz zmatq kc tqarlapxpele nide,

napibzkr kx ncblo lc tqtubz mz mzpu mrlztx-atwrnrpengr mzbq ka mz zmatq ngr Jiszs Kxnzmcpx kc Naszret, tqtqlvztramu mz kros. A' atulz-mop Gct mz nzbzngr, x da angidr lc nakrlzamu amrlx ngrmu x lr Israel amrlx.
Murde krlc ‘rplz kc etu tzpxtxpx-ngrdr ncblo kcng tzrwz-ngrng ma, nzaelwapxngr kx nide nou rplz kc tqmyatxpx-zlwzbz.’ Jiszs esz'-krde tqngi nou rplz lc tqmyatxpx-zlwzbz.
X trpnz-moungr lrpzki r nzrlapxngr, a' ngi txpwz mz nzrlxngtingr Jiszs. Murde trpnz-moungr doa mz nrlc ka kx krlzle nzarlapxngr leplz.”
Pita x Jon nelzdr br mz nzycmnengr, kxmule-esz' trnzsiklu-angidrung x trnzalvztr-pnzu nidr mz lou sc Mosis. Zbz kxnzrmailz ngrdr lr Jiu nzkctitxpxlr, x sc tzkrlz-atelr kx nzmncng ena badr Jiszs.
Nzrpilr na-angi-brmrdatitx-ngrdr aposol kcng, a' trtxpnzngr da kx napilr, murde nzmcpelr ncblo kc brngzpe.
Sc tzrpipebzlr kx navzpxng mz Kansrl kc murde naryapwx-lxblrng.
Sc tzrpi-etrpelr kx, “?Nike nawaisrpe-ngrgu ncblo kang? Rblx nzayrplapx-krgu nidr murde otxpxbz mz leplz amrlx mrka kx Gct batrpzle nzale-krdr da kxmatq-esz'ngr. X rblx kz nzrpi-krgu kx trtingr.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, mz nzaesaki-ngrbz da lc nztalvzpx-krde mz mzlir leplz kcng, na-amwxlrku ncblo lcng kx bzkq nzycmne-mopwzng badr mz drtq Jiszs.”
Zbz nzrpibzlr mz Pita x Jon kx nayzlu-mopqng brma. X mz natqdr kx xplr nzrpibzlr kx bzkq nzyapwxtipelr Jiszs x bzkq nzalvztrpe-ngrdr nide.
A' rpibz Pita nidr mz Jon kx, “?Mz drtwrmu nike tubq mz nzobqkr Gct, nzvz-nqblqngr natqmu o natqde?
Murde mz nzvz-nqblq-krgr natqde, rblxm bagr nzesakikr nzpipx-krgr da kcng tqmcpekr tqale Jiszs x da kcng tqxlrkr mz nzalvztr-krdeng.”
Mz nibr kzdung mou natq ngr nzamwxlrngr kx nzkabzlr, sc tzrlrpxpe-ngrbzlr nzvz-krdr. Rblx nzayrplapx-krdr nidr, murde mzli lc leplz amrlx nzglqlzlr Gct mz da kcng tqprtz.
Murde ncblo kc tqbxplo pnz mz nzrmcngr mzte, mrlzpe mz zmatq ngr Jiszs. X yiz ngrde myaszlzle kx nzpnu-pwx (40).
Aposol Kcng Tzkrka'-ngrdr Nzrlxngitingr Kx Xplr
Mzli kc tzrlrpxpe-ngrbzlr nzvzpx-krdr, Pita x Jon sc tzyzlupe-mopwzng mz kxnzrlxngiting x nzpibzlr badr da kcng tzpibz kxnzetu ngr Kansrl kc.
Kx nzxlrbzlrle, sc tzamnctr-lzbqpeng mz nzkrka'-krbzlr mz Gct mz drtwr kxesz'. Nzrpibzlr kx, “Kxetu rgr, nim Kxrpalz kc tqwz-ngrde bongavz, nrlc x prla, x dalrdrng amrlx.
Mqngrkxtr batrpzle mz melrmqgr King Devet nzycmnengr nzrpi-krde kx, ‘Lr mrkzbleng nzngqngung mz nzngyatikr drtwrdr Yawe. Murde mane nzyrlqtingr nide drtwr kxtrka.
King rdrng x kxnzrmailz rdrng nzyrlwr-lxblrng mz nzoliqti-krdr nzota-krdr badr Yawe x Kxnzmcpx nede.’

Natq Devet lc atukztrpe Jiszs! Murde King Herot Antipas x Pcntizs Paelzt nzyrlwr-lxblrbzng mrka Jerusalem badr kxtrngiulrJiu x lr Jiu. Nzryrlqting drtwr mz nzatrkati-krdr Jiszs, kxnzawz nem kxtr, kc tqmcpxq.
Mz nzvz-nqblq-krde me pnz drtwrm x zmatq ngrm, nzatutrlr da kcng amrlx tqyrlq pnz drtwrm kx nangida.
X mzli ka, kx Kxetu, na-aoti drtwrm nzamwxlr-krdr nigr. X rlr-ngrm bagr, nigr kxnzawz nemqng, nzpipx-krgr natqm mz nelz kxbr.
X aelwapxngr zmatq ngrm mz nzamrlzngr zyagox x nzalengr da kxmatq kxnzkctipxngr zmatq ngr Jiszs, kxnzawz nem kxtr. Eu, angida.”
Mzli kc tqyrkrpxpe-ngrbz nzkrka'-krdr, mrkc tzkrka'-ngrdr aycngrlrlzm Gct. Zbz Mqngrkxtr prsrle nidr, murde narpipxng Nrpa ngr Jiszs mz nelz kxbr.
Kxnzrlxngiting Nzakilr Dztudrng
Krkcng tzrlxngiting nzesz'ting mz nabzdr x mz drtwrdr. Trpnzngr nidr kx rpile kx dztudeng scde esz'-krde. A' nidr amrlx ngrdr nzakibzlr dztudrng mz kztedrng kxtrnzrngiscung.
Mz zmatq ngr Mqngrkxtr nzyapwxtipx aposol kcng nztulz-krm Jiszs mz nzbzngr. X natqdr pnamilxtile nabz leplz kx kqlu. Murde Gct okatr-zvzle nidr amrlx ngrdr mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz.
Trpnzngr nidr kx tr-rngiscu da. Murde kxnzrlxngiting nzamwalr lclr da o ma nyzdr,
x nzaprcbzlr trau ngrdeng mz aposol kcng mz nzaki-krbzlrle mz doa kxesz' mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nike takitrde nide.

Kzdq ncblo drtqde Josip ale-kzle da lc. Aposol kcng tzrpi-kzpzlr drtqde Banabas mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nqmq krde. Murde drtq lc drtwr ngrde mrlx kx axglr leplz. Nide nqvi lr Livae x mzte nzmc mz Trmctu Saepras.
Amwale kzdq lclr da nyzde kxetu x aprcbzle trau rde mz aposol kcng.

footnotes.text: Kzdung mzli Gct aelwapx-ngrde me mnc-ngrde mz nengq. [Nzrlaszngr 19:18; Asaea 6:4]
